about_the_game:
NO JOKES WITH MAGES

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric quest where fears take the form of mysterious "mages". Explore a new world where you've become trapped, helping Dwight overcome his inner demons in the mystical realm of Limb.

KEY FEATURES

🔮 UNIQUE WORLD OF LIMBO Explore a surrealist world where familiar places become distorted by the protagonist's emotions. Each location is a reflection of Dwight's inner experiences, filled with symbolism and mysteries.

📖 CAPTIVATING STORY Dive into an emotional coming-of-age journey. Uncover the secrets of Dwight's subconscious and help him face his fears head-on.

🎨 ATMOSPHERIC VISUAL STYLE Experience unique artistic direction where every detail conveys the hero's emotional state. Watch as the familiar world transforms under the influence of inner turmoil.

🎮 INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY Controls are designed to complement the story and atmosphere - intuitive, simple, and satisfying.

ABOUT THE GAME

"No Jokes with Mages" is a story that everyone has experienced in some way. It's a journey into the depths of human consciousness, where ordinary teenager Dwight encounters mages - physical manifestations of his fears and doubts. In this mysterious world known as Limbo, familiar reality becomes distorted, creating a unique space for exploring the hero's emotions and self-discovery.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Deep Dialogue System: Every conversation can lead to unexpected discoveries

  • Intuitive Puzzles: Solve riddles based on the hero's emotional state

  • Atmospheric Soundtrack: Music that enhances your immersion in the game's world

Embark on an unforgettable journey through "No Jokes with Mages," where every plot twist brings you closer to uncovering the mysteries of the subconscious.

short_description: Embark on a surreal journey into Limb, where your fears take shape as enigmatic mages. Join Dwight, a troubled teenager, as he navigates a shifting reality of inner struggles. Face your demons and uncover the mysteries of the subconscious in this atmospheric and mind-bending adventure.
